purpose: Workflow for extracting requirements from an existing application source code and writing requirements documents, keeping functionality while allowing a redesign of the look.
summary: Required reading list: requirement principles, format, error classification, boundary, priorities, style guide
Purpose: preserve features, renew design, not clone the existing design
Phase 1: confirm design policy and source path, fetch rules and specs, launch parallel context-collection agents
Phase 2: analyze project structure, screens and components, navigation, treatment of design elements
Phase 3: requirement extraction priority order and practical steps for actions, branches, persistence, error handling
Phase 4: placement and ID numbering, creation order, What-only writing principles, glossary
Phase 5: quality checks, AI review, reference existence check placeholder, specs index update, commit confirmation
Completion guidance with the next start-design command
